spans.s:
mamma, m. N.: -ka, m. N.;
 -ṭa, m. [orig. 🞄mahima-bhaṭṭa] N. of the author of the 🞄Kāvyaprakāśa.

māma, m. [belonging to mine: mama], 🞄dear friend (only vc., the crane being thus addressed 🞄in the fable by crabs, tortoises, and 🞄fishes, and the ass by the jackal): -ká, a. 🞄(ikā, ī) belonging to me, mine, my;
 -k-ina, 🞄a. my, mine.
mamā-ya, den. Ā. envy any one (ac.).
